Presentation.title: Hello, I'm Giovanni Vicentin
Presentation.description: I am a software engineer working daily with `.tsx`, `.jsx`, `.ts`, `.js`, `.html`, and `.py`, focused on building web experiences that are accessible, fast, and responsive. I care about readable code, solid UX, and making things work well across the board. Always learning both as a coder and a person, I take things step by step, powered by patience, curiosity, and a steady grind.

itau.title: Software Engineer
itau.description: Develop and support the Itaú app’s tab bar hub. Implemented local caching in the backend and rebuilt the complete frontend journey from scratch using WebView. Currently modernizing the visual experience for the app’s relaunch and pioneering a new engineering initiative focused on specification-driven development (SDD), AI agents, skills, and MCP.

carrefour.description: Revamped the Sam’s Club registration system, created APIs to manage user data, and optimized the platform, increasing the membership base, engagement, and site performance.

talst.description: Developed software focused on increasing system efficiency, automating processes, and enhancing performance metrics across various projects.

bigO.title: Big O Analyzer
bigO.description: Analyze algorithm time complexity instantly in JavaScript, Python, and Java.
bigO.expandedDescription: An intelligent static-analysis tool that detects Big O time complexity from JavaScript, Python, and Java source code. It combines a Monaco code editor with syntax validation, clear explanations, optimization suggestions, and a visual complexity reference. Its custom pipeline parses code into an AST, normalizes it into an intermediate representation, builds a control-flow graph, and heuristically evaluates loops, recursion, native methods, and common algorithm patterns.

megazord.title: Megazord — The Woodie Flowers Box
megazord.description: An accessible collection of games and hands-on activities for learning STEAM concepts.
megazord.expandedDescription: A Portuguese-language educational platform inspired by Woodie Flowers that introduces children to STEAM through practical, playful activities. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and accessible Radix UI components, it brings together interactive experiences including checkers, chess, tic-tac-toe, a periodic-table memory game, drawing tools, and a collaborative whiteboard.

ebookToAudiobook.title: Ebook to Audiobook
ebookToAudiobook.description: Convert PDF and EPUB ebooks into audio privately, right in the browser.
ebookToAudiobook.expandedDescription: A browser-based reading companion that turns PDF and EPUB files into audiobooks using voices available on the user's own device. The experience is designed for convenience and privacy: books are processed locally, without uploading their contents to a server, so users can listen to their library while keeping their files under their control.

mindfulMinutes.title: Mindful Minutes
mindfulMinutes.description: Guided mindfulness practices for reducing stress, improving focus, and building consistency.
mindfulMinutes.expandedDescription: A privacy-first progressive web app for guided breathing, digital Tratak meditation, and progressive muscle relaxation. Sessions are customizable and supported by progress analytics, streaks, a practice calendar, and achievements. The app works offline, stores data locally, supports light and dark themes, and is localized in eight languages.

frankMetalicas.title: Frank Metálicas
frankMetalicas.description: Development of a website for Frank Metálicas, focusing on digital presence and SEO optimization.
frankMetalicas.expandedDescription: I developed a website for Frank Metálicas with the goal of establishing a robust digital presence, making it easier to showcase products and services, display completed projects, and connect with clients. Using technologies like Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Node.js, Zod, and React Hook Form, I optimized the website for search engines, boosting the company’s visibility on Google. As a result, there was a significant increase in contact inquiries and the company gained prominence in online searches.
